title: fix(plugin-chatbot): confirm-changes card actions wait until no turn is in flight (objectui#10965)
body:
Fixes #10965
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

The confirm-changes card (确认修改) renders as soon as `update_metadata` returns `changes_proposed`, while the proposing turn is still streaming. Its `proposed-changes-confirm` and `proposed-changes-adjust` buttons had no `disabled`, and `handleChangesConfirm` calls `onSendMessage` straight away, so a Confirm in that window sent the next turn while the previous one was still in flight. The proposed-plan card had the same overlap until objectui#10925.

Following the card's Direction, both buttons now carry `disabled={planActionsLocked}` (that is, `isLoading`, the signal objectui#10925 introduced) and the same `disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50` classes as the plan card. No new signal is added.

- **One hunk, in `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`.** It covers the card's default branch only. The `applying` (optimistic `confirmPendingIds` and replay), quota-blocked (objectui#7253), legacy `confirmed` and no-`onSendMessage` hint branches all `return` before that branch, so none of them changes.
- **Name kept.** `planActionsLocked` keeps its name. Renaming it would edit the plan-card lines, and those fall outside the claim's declared file surface.
- **Files.** Nothing else changed beyond the new pin beside the objectui#10925 one and `.changeset/10965-changes-card-wait-stream.md` (patch, `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`).

## Acceptance, mapped to the pin

`packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.changesActionsWaitForTurn-10965.test.tsx` builds every case from the wire shape through the real `uiMessagesToChatMessages(wire, { isStreaming: isLoading })`, with `isLoading = submitted | streaming`. This is the same harness as the objectui#10925 pin.

1. **Disabled in flight.** Confirm and Adjust are disabled while the proposing turn streams, and a click sends nothing and does not flip the card to Applying. An older card is also held while a newer turn is `submitted` (no message carries `streaming`) and while it is `streaming` below the card.
2. **Enabled at `ready`.** Moving from `streaming` to `ready` enables both, and Confirm then sends `changesConfirmMessage` exactly once.
3. **Other states unchanged.** One case drives each of the card's own states with a turn in flight and asserts its badge renders with neither action present:
   - `applying`, reached two ways: the optimistic flip after a click, and a `replay_` re-dispatch still running on the streaming tail;
   - quota-blocked, after a 429 `AI_DESIGN_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED`, which stays parked with its reason while a later turn is `submitted`;
   - legacy `confirmed`, from a later same-tool commit on the streaming turn;
   - the read-only hint when there is no `onSendMessage`.

## Evidence (all runs at `f9140e6`, the branch head)

- **Before the fix,** on base `b120b66`, the new pin measured `Tests 3 failed | 1 passed (4)`, and each failure was `Received element is not disabled`. The states case was green there too, as expected: it guards unchanged behaviour and does not depend on the gate.
- **Reverse verification on the committed tree.** It went through objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, with the mutation proven on disk (anchor count 1 then 0, blob moved) and restore proven (blob equals the HEAD blob `4ab789d9a885`, `git diff HEAD` empty). There was one leg per button, and the direction was as predicted:
  - with the Confirm gate set to `disabled={false}`: `Tests 3 failed | 1 passed (4)`, the three gate cases;
  - with the Adjust gate set to `disabled={false}`: `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`, exactly the two cases that assert Adjust is disabled.
- **Touched suites.** The new pin plus the 10925 pin, `changesCard`, `replayOutcome`, `quotaBlockedConfirm`, `awaitingConfirmBuild-8343` and `toolCardHeaderState-7254` gave `Test Files 7 passed (7)`, `Tests 42 passed (42)`.
- **Package suite.** `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/` gave `Test Files 53 passed (53)`, `Tests 557 passed (557)`.
- **Type-check.** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exited 0, after building the dependency closure `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot^...` (9 packages). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new pin once.
- **Build.** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot build` exited 0.
- **eslint.** eslint on the two touched `.tsx` files gave 0 errors. Its JSON output counts 2 files. The 10 warnings on `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` are all outside this hunk and were already there. `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `projectService`, `parserOptions.project` or TypeChecked preset), so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.
- **Changeset and citation gates.** These all exited 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new) and `check-control-bytes`.
- **Test-hygiene gates.** These all exited 0: `check-test-path-roots`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-shell-escape-residue`, `check-comment-mask-corpus` (its one known residue is not in these files) and `check-lint-coverage`.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the three paths answered NOT GOVERNED, and its `AGENTS.md` control exits 3 GOVERNED. This PR stays draft regardless, because it came from a dispatch.

`check-changeset-claims` asked one question of this diff: `.changeset/6687-chatbot-surface-authorable.md` names `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`. That paragraph is about `surface` / `isPlainSurface`, and this diff touches neither, so the paragraph stays true.

## Acceptance notes

- Adjust on this card only focuses the composer and sends nothing. It is gated anyway, per the card's Direction, to match the plan card's Adjust.
- The README does not describe this card. PR objectui#10952 (objectui#10925) shipped with the same three-file shape, so no README or guide edit is owed here.
